title: 電漿增強化學氣相沉積
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究電漿與成膜、膜性與應力、三維覆蓋、整合與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: plasma and growth, film properties and stress, 3d coverage, integration and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「電漿增強化學氣相沉積」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「畫出電漿活化到表面反應路徑」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：較快成膜可能改變氫含量、應力與電性。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「電漿與薄膜：深度、覆蓋與端點」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：電漿增強化學氣相沉積 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「較快成膜可能改變氫含量、應力與電性」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition as the task boundary. After reading “Trace plasma activation into surface growth”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Faster deposition can alter hydrogen content, stress and electrical properties. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Plasma and films: depth, coverage and endpoint”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Faster deposition can alter hydrogen content, stress and electrical properties” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 完成「畫出電漿活化到表面反應路徑」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Trace plasma activation into surface growth", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 氣相與表面反應共同參與沉積。
較低溫度就能保證完全無電漿損傷。
厚度相同就表示介電品質相同。
optionsEn: Gas-phase and surface reactions both contribute to deposition.
Lower temperature guarantees no plasma damage.
Equal thickness proves equal dielectric quality.
quiz.explanation: 氣相與表面反應共同參與沉積。 PECVD 利用電漿活化反應，較低基板溫度不代表所有損傷都較低。
quiz.explanationEn: Gas-phase and surface reactions both contribute to deposition. PECVD activates reactions with plasma; lower substrate temperature does not guarantee lower total damage.

quiz.explanation: 不同用途需要不同膜性目標。 PECVD 利用電漿活化反應，較低基板溫度不代表所有損傷都較低。
quiz.explanationEn: Different uses require different film-property targets. PECVD activates reactions with plasma; lower substrate temperature does not guarantee lower total damage.
